values.summary: Revenue and go-to-market operator with eight years of full-cycle B2B, media, and enterprise technology sales. Founder of Strategic Market Insights, a consulting and GTM engineering practice whose key engagement advises a healthcare AI start-up's CEO and board on go-to-market, pricing, and buy-vs-build strategy. Wins net-new business from cold, from Fortune 500 accounts at TEKsystems to NFL and MLB team partnerships, by building the CPM, CPA, and unit-economics case a finance team can defend. Has led a team of up to five and builds AI-enabled GTM tooling with Claude Code.
